source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: no other nominee remained after the withdrawals (News-Letter, 7 January 1927)

note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation), nominations 5 January, poll Saturday 15 January 1927. Seven retiring members were returned unopposed after Zimri Stewart withdrew in St Anne's, and eight wards were contested (Belfast News-Letter, 6, 7 and 17 January 1927). Returned unopposed.
